name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: GHOST OF THE DUSK
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 GHOST OF THE DUSK
source:
A body was discovered in a “haunted house” in west Aspicio. While investigating this incident, Jake got to know the house’s owner, Mel Darks, who told him that he felt the place actually was cursed.

Almost as if speaking of the curse willed it into existence, a string of grisly incidents tied to the house immediately occurred.

What were the secrets hidden in this place?

And who or what was this “ghost” dogging Jake at every turn?

In this case, our detective faces danger the likes of which he’s never seen before.

[From [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/jakehunter/story/]Aksys Games[/url]]
translation:
西阿斯皮西奥的一座“鬼屋”里发现了一具尸体。调查过程中，Jake认识了房屋主人Mel Darks。她告诉Jake，自己觉得这里确实被诅咒了。

仿佛只要谈论诅咒就会将其召来，与房屋有关的一连串血腥事件立即发生。

这里隐藏着什么秘密？

每当Jake行动时，那个“幽灵”究竟为何、又是什么在纠缠着他？

这一次，侦探将面对前所未有的危险。

（来源：[url=http://www.aksysgames.com/jakehunter/story/]Aksys Games[/url]）
